'''12 Galactar Route''' was a house in an elaborate and expensive condominium complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seltos]], in [[Sommin City]]. It was the home of [[Magister of Trade]] [[Sinya Deboora]] and her husband, [[Marse Deboora]].
